currentParagraphText: “With that matter settled... I am curious to learn more about the history of vampires. The parts most people don’t know, as I’m sure several factions have done much to suppress or erase your history,” the Sword Saint said.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “With that matter settled... I am curious to learn more about the history of vampires. The parts most people don’t know, as I’m sure several factions have done much to suppress or erase your history,” the Sword Saint said.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Truthfully, he wasn’t that interested, but he knew the vampires liked to speak of their history, and he didn’t lie when he said he held some level of curiosity. Plus, the more he knew, the better he could avoid making any mistakes while dealing with high-level vampires in the future. It was something he had a feeling he would end up doing quite a lot, considering his plans to forge a good relationship between the six families and the Noboru clan.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I perhaps overstepped,” the True Ancestor acknowledged her mistake. Meanwhile, Fairleigh was merely looking at them while clearly trying to handle the pressure from being in the presence of a powerful god. He wasn’t looking that good. Contrarily, the Sword Saint had already adapted to her aura, and while he could certainly still feel her presence, it was quite manageable.
